manhattan.line: The klieg lights shoot up over the skyline of Manhattan
stanza: Outside it's a bright night, there's an opera at Lincoln Center
The klieg lights shoot up over the skyline of Manhattan
But the lights are out on the mean streets

manhattan.line: And span the length of the Isle of Manhattan
stanza: If I could open my arms
And span the length of the Isle of Manhattan
I'd bring it to where you are
Making a lake of the East River and Hudson
If I could open my mouth
Wide enough for a marching band to march out
They would make your name sing
And bend through alleys and bounce off all the buildings
